info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Current Account Details API
info.description: The Corporate Current Account Details API provides access to detailed information for corporate current accounts. This endpoint enables users to retrieve specific account information based on the provided account identifier. Typically used by financial institutions and corporate clients, this API facilitates account management and reporting. It is ideal for developers looking to integrate banking functionalities into their applications and improve the overall user experience in corporate financial management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific corporate current account, identified by its account number. You can use this information to assess account status, transaction history, and balances pertinent to corporate banking operations.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving operations related to the corporate current account with ID ACC-200045. The structure contains necessary parameters and fields that are required for fetching the relevant account operations.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the current account details are returned.

GetCorporateCurrentAccountDetailsRequest.description: A request body that contains information related to the corporate current account operations. This is typically a placeholder for capturing JSON request data pertaining to the operation of the specified account.
